summary: Huron Intermediate School District argues for expanded E‑Rate eligibility, higher rural discounts, continued support for Head‑Start/Pre‑K, network‑level filtering for all devices, and clearer consultant definitions. A school district urges the FCC to preserve core E‑Rate functions, maintain eligibility for special construction and other services, keep discount methodology fair, protect applicants from provider filing delays, and avoid unnecessary administrative burdens.
